messages:
emma-cs: quick check-in: OrbitHealth sees sporadic 429s during onboarding ramp. They spawn lots of short-lived workers for preflight + embed warmups. Logs attached.

tara-orbithealth: yep. we start ~200 tiny processes, works for a minute then 429 flood. no code changes, just more workers.

emma-cs: sample from their edge: 
```
2026-03-19T18:12:01Z POST /v1/preflight 200
2026-03-19T18:12:01Z POST /v1/embeds 429 preflight_quota_exhausted
2026-03-19T18:12:02Z POST /v1/preflight 429 token_lease_wait
2026-03-19T18:12:03Z POST /v1/embeds 429 retry_after=2
```

sam-devex: likely causes: ephemeral token lease limits + preflight per-connection checks. Creating a new SDK client per worker exacerbates both.

tara-orbithealth: we can't refactor to pooled clients today. any quick mitigations?

sam-devex: non-code options: set SDK env flags (reads on import), add jitter to worker start, or use a tiny sidecar. example envs: 
```
REDWOOD_SDK_KEEP_ALIVE=true
REDWOOD_SDK_PRELIGHT_SPLAY_MS=200
REDWOOD_SDK_MAX_CONCURRENT_PRELIGHT=12
REDWOOD_SDK_EPHEMERAL_LEASE_MODE=multiplex
```

rafael-infra: server-side short-term option: increase ephemeral lease count for the account while they ramp and add a fallback policy to route to lower-rate models if token pressure rises. Tara, want a temporary bump?

tara-orbithealth: yes please. 3x preflight capacity for 4 hours would let us finish warmup.

emma-cs: on it, scheduling a 15-min coordination call. @rafael-infra can you post the audit id after change?

rafael-infra: applied temporary policy, audit id audit_20260319_087. token-bot will post lease change. Also added a watch for 5xx increases.

token-bot: note: ephemeral_lease_count for key orbit_key_47 bumped 20->60 until 2026-03-19T22:15:00Z.

tara-orbithealth: after applying env flags + bump, 429s dropped sharply and warmup finished. thank you.

emma-cs: next steps we agreed on:
- short-term: keep preflight_splay enabled during rollout window
- medium: implement lightweight pooling helper (we'll share a 10-line snippet) or drop an nginx sidecar into the runner image
- infra: we'll revoke the temporary lease bump after 4h and monitor

sam-devex: i'll DM the pooling snippet and a sidecar example they can drop in without changing app code.

emma-cs: closing the thread for now; reopen if regressions appear. :thumbsup:
